SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, KEY_3 AS LEGACY_GR_NO, KEY_4 AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM KII_PO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GRDOWN' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'BING' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(B.STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, A.KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, A.KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(B.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(B.CURRENCY_CODE,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(B.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(B.GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(B.GR_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, NVL(B.GR_DATE,' ') AS GR_DATE, NVL(B.LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, A.KEY_3 AS LEGACY_GR_NO, A.KEY_4 AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, NVL(B.DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(B.RO_QTY,0) AS RO_QTY, NVL(B.RO_AMT,0) AS RO_AMT, NVL(B.REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM APPS.KII_PO_KEP_RCV_V B, KII_PO_KEPTRXL A WHERE A.KEY_1 = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND A.KEY_2 = B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND A.KEY_3 = B.LEGACY_GR_NO AND A.KEY_4 = B.LEGACY_GR_SEQ AND A.DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND A.KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND A.KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND TRIM(A.KEY_9) IS NULL ORDER BY A.KEY_1,A.KEY_2,B.LEGACY_GR_NO,B.LEGACY_GR_SEQ
UPDATE KII_PO_KEPTRXL A SET KEY_9 = CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APPS.KII_PO_KEP_RCV_V B WHERE A.KEY_1 = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND A.KEY_2 = B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND A.KEY_3 = B.LEGACY_GR_NO AND A.KEY_4 = B.LEGACY_GR_SEQ) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'E' END , KEY_8 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL
